facts.summary: Missed primary endpoint, no path forward in painful DPN · Phase 2b · NYX-2925 in painful diabetic peripheral neuropathy · not yet approved

evidence.summary: NYX-2925 did not achieve statistically significant separation from placebo on the study’s primary endpoint, which assessed the change from baseline in average daily pain on the numeric rating scale (NRS) during week 12.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: The primary endpoint of the study was not achieved.
evidence.safety: NYX-2925 was well tolerated in the study, with no concerning safety issues observed.
evidence.program_discontinued: Unfortunately, the data from this study do not currently point to a path forward in development for painful DPN.
